registers.name: MetaFrameLength
registers.desc: Words between metaframe control-word groups on each lane (e.g. 2048)

registers.name: BurstMax
registers.desc: Maximum payload bytes between Control Words (typical 256)

registers.name: BurstShort
registers.desc: Burst size for packets shorter than BurstMin (typical 32)

registers.name: BurstMin
registers.desc: Minimum payload between Control Words for a non-final burst (multiple of 32, typical 64)

registers.name: LaneCount
registers.desc: Number of bonded SerDes lanes N (implementation-defined, e.g. 4/10/12/24)

registers.name: ChannelCount
registers.desc: Number of active logical channels (up to 65536)

base_address: Defined at SoC level; offsets given relative to module base.
notes: Module memory map per spec. Reads from reserved bits return zeros and writes to reserved bits have no effect.
note: Interlaken is a protocol definition, not a register-file device; these are link configuration parameters.
